title: Installation & Service Engineer
description:
Installation and Service Engineer

Location: Remote UK, Germany or Poland.
Contract: Full‑time, Permanent
Hours: 40 per week

Would you like to be part of a team that is enabling technology for a better world? Kurt J. Lesker could be the place for you!

About the role:
We are currently looking for an Installation and Service Engineer to join our Process Equipment Division. You will be responsible for various system installations across Europe, troubleshooting both mechanical and electro-mechanical assemblies, as well as providing technical support for both our internal and external customers.

This role offers an excellent opportunity to work with innovative technologies, support leading organisations across a range of industries, and make a real impact on customer success.

About us:
Kurt J. Lesker Company (KJLC) is a global leader in advanced manufacturing, delivering high-performance vacuum products and systems that power innovation across semiconductor, aerospace, medical, and optical industries. With over 70 years of expertise, we’re trusted by some of the world’s most critical sectors to support the development of next-generation technologies. We’re proud to be recognised for our commitment to sustainability, ethical practices, and a workplace culture that values excellence.

Role expectations:

• Provide system installation and support for both KJLC/KDF PVD tools

• Trouble-shooting of any level mechanical, electro-mechanical assemblies or coating systems

• Performing preventative maintenance, system upgrades, and field modifications

• Interaction with customers regarding service enquiries via phone, email and video-conferencing

• Travelling to customer sites across the UK and Europe to carry out installation, service, and support activities

• Delivering customer training on system operation, software, and hardware

• Thorough understanding of software navigation and PC operation

• Interpreting technical drawings, schematics, and system documentation

• Ability to perform helium leak detection and perform basic analysis using a Residual Gas Analyzer (RGA)

• Building strong relationships with customers and acting as a trusted technical advisor

What we are looking for:

• BSc in a scientific discipline (e.g. physics, chemistry, materials science etc.)

• 5+ years experience in a field service, installation, service engineering, or similar technical role

• Thorough understanding of vacuum technology and thin film deposition techniques and processes

• Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills

• Strong communication skills

• Ability to travel regularly throughout the UK and internationally.

Benefits:

• Competitive salary

• 25 days annual leave + bank holidays

• Matched pension up to 5%

• Health Cash Plan offering £600 per annum towards your standard healthcare costs for both you and your family, plus access to a free 24-hour doctor service

• Income protection insurance

• Cycle to work scheme

• Enhanced maternity/paternity pay

• Corporate, wellness and charity events throughout the year with the option to earn an extra day of annual leave

Please note we have a PSL in place and are unable to accept speculative CV’s from recruitment agencies.

Kurt J Lesker Company Ltd is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified individuals, irrespective of race, ethnicity, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, religion or belief, marital status, or any other protected characteristic.

Applicants who require reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process are encouraged to contact us in advance so that appropriate arrangements can be made.

For further information or assistance, please contact

J. Lesker Company Ltd is a limited company

title: Sr. Site Reliability Engineer- Federal
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Sr. Site Reliability Engineer (Production Engineer) to join our team. This is a hybrid role (onsite three days a week in Santa Clara, CA, reporting to the Senior Manager, Site Reliability Engineering in the Zero Trust Exchange department.

As a key member of the Zero Trust Exchange team, you will own the systems-level reliability and performance of Zscaler’s high-throughput bare-metal and cloud infrastructure processing tens of billions of daily transactions across a global, multi-region fleet. This is a software-first SRE role: you will write production-grade code and automation, drive the shift from reactive incident response, and bring engineering discipline to the systems-level work - OS, network and application debugging - that keeps the fleet operating safely at scale.

What You’ll Do (Role Expectations)

• Maintain high availability across large-scale bare-metal Linux/BSD fleets, Kubernetes clusters, and custom routing stacks in partnership with Engineering and Networking teams

• Lead full-cycle incident response by conducting cross-stack troubleshooting using low-level OS and network tools (strace, lsof, tcpdump, iostat, vmstat, gdb), maintain high availability across large-scale bare metal Linux /BSD fleets and Kubernetes clusters

• Automate infrastructure lifecycle management, service provisioning, configuration workflows, and release deployments using Ansible, Python, and Go; quantify operational toil and convert recurring manual work into durable, version-controlled, testable automation - tracking reduction as an engineering outcome

• Own end-to-end telemetry (metrics, logs, traces) using Prometheus and OpenTelemetry ecosystems; define and enforce SLOs/error budgets to reduce alert noise

• Perform architectural reviews, OS/kernel upgrades, capacity and performance tuning, strict CI/CD validation prior to production rollouts; embed operability standards (telemetry, rollback safety, SLO readiness) into service design from the start

Who You Are (Success Profile)

• You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.

• You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.

• You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.

title: Remote C/C++ Software Engineer - Data Recovery Tools
description:
Overview
DriveSavers is seeking an experienced software engineer with expertise in C/C++ and familiarity with storage technologies to help enhance our data recovery toolset. This is a highly technical, hands-on position focused on analyzing proprietary storage and backup formats, and developing robust recovery tools to retrieve critical customer data from damaged or inaccessible systems.
Responsibilities

• Analyze proprietary on-disk formats and metadata to identify recovery strategies across all layers of the storage stack

• Design and implement libraries and applications in C/C++ (or other suitable languages) for parsing, reconstructing and extracting data from a variety of storage systems, file system and backup applications.

• Collaborate with engineering teams to validate tool output and improve recovery workflows

• Contribute to build system and automation infrastructure by integrating tools with source control, CI pipelines, and dependency managers (e.g., Git, GitHub Actions, Conan)

Skills required

• Advanced proficiency in C/C++, with a focus on systems-level and performance-critical development

• Experience with binary data formats, storage technologies and file system internals

• Familiarity with backup solutions and technologies

• Familiarity with compression and encryption algorithms and implementations

• Bonus: Experience in static and dynamic binary analysis, malware analysis, or digital forensics (e.g., IDA Pro, Ghidra)

• Bonus: Working knowledge of Python or Rust for scripting and prototyping

Additional Information

• This is a remote position open to candidates worldwide

• Availability for some collaboration during U.S. business hours is preferred

• Confidentiality and data security are critical -- background screening may be required

Interested?
If you're passionate about low-level development and solving complex data recovery challenges, we'd love to hear from you. Reach out directly for more information.

title: Ingénieur·e de recherche en identification d'état pour les systèmes temps réel réactifs – CDD 3 mois
tags: Génie des procédés, système de production et fabrication avancée
description:
Présentation de Télécom SudParis :
Télécom SudParis est une grande école publique d'ingénieurs reconnue au meilleur niveau des sciences et technologies du numérique. La qualité de ses formations est basée sur l’excellence scientifique de son corps professoral et une pédagogie mettant l’accent sur les projets d’équipes, l’innovation de rupture et l’entreprenariat. Télécom SudParis compte 1 000 étudiantes et étudiants dont 700 élèves ingénieurs et environ de 150 doctorantes et doctorants. Télécom SudParis fait partie de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’école d’ingénieurs en France, et partage son campus avec Institut Mines-Télécom Business School. Télécom SudParis est co- fondatrice de l'Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris), Institut de Sciences et Technologies à vocation mondiale avec l’École polytechnique, l’ENSTA Paris, l’ENSAE Paris, l'ENPC et Télécom Paris. Vidéo présentation de Télécom SudParis
À propos de l'Institut Mines-Télécom :
L'Institut Mines-Télécom (IMT) est un établissement public dédié à l'enseignement supérieur et la recherche pour l'innovation dans les domaines de l'ingénierie et du numérique. À l’écoute permanente du monde économique, l'IMT conjugue une forte légitimité académique et scientifique, une proximité avec les entreprises et un positionnement unique sur les transformations majeures au XXIe siècle : numériques, énergétiques, industrielles et éducatives siècle. Ses activités se déploient au sein des grandes écoles Mines et Télécom sous tutelle du ministre en charge de l’Industrie et des communications électroniques, de deux filiales et de partenaires associés ou sous convention. L'IMT est membre fondateur de l’Alliance Industrie du Futur. Il est doublement labellisé Carnot pour la qualité de sa recherche partenariale. Vidéo de présentation de l'Institut Mines-Télécom
Missions

• Conduire des travaux de recherche fondamentale et appliquée en informatique sur l’identification d’état et la détection des conditions de compétition dans les systèmes temps réel.

• Étudier et développer des approches visant à améliorer la fiabilité et les performances des systèmes de réseaux distribués.

• Mobiliser des modèles formels temps réel, des méthodes d’identification d’état et des stratégies de détection des conditions de compétition.

• Contribuer au développement de nouvelles méthodes d’analyse et de vérification des systèmes temps réel.

Activités
1. Mener des travaux de recherche sur l’identification d’état et la détection des conditions de compétition dans les systèmes temps réel

• Participer activement et régulièrement aux réunions de l’équipe de recherche.

• Collaborer avec les membres de l’équipe à la conduite des travaux scientifiques.

• Modéliser des systèmes de réseaux distribués à l’aide d’automates temporisés ( Timed Automata ) et de machines à états finis temporisées ( Timed Finite State Machines ).

• Spécifier et vérifier des propriétés temporelles, notamment les conditions de compétition, à l’aide de solveurs et d’outils de vérification formelle tels qu’UPPAAL.

• Mettre en œuvre et évaluer des méthodes existantes de génération de séquences d’identification d’état pour les automates temporisés et les machines à états finis temporisées, notamment les séquences de synchronisation ( synchronizing sequences ), de détermination de l’état initial ( homing sequences ) et de distinction ( distinguishing sequences ).

• Exploiter des techniques telles que les arbres de successeurs et les méthodes d’abstraction pour dériver des séquences d’identification d’état.

• Concevoir de nouvelles stratégies d’identification d’état et de détection des conditions de compétition.

• Réaliser des expérimentations, analyser les résultats et évaluer les performances des méthodes développées.

2. Valoriser et diffuser les résultats de recherche

• Rédiger des articles scientifiques et contribuer à leur publication dans des revues et conférences internationales.

• Présenter les résultats des travaux lors

The AI Risk and Governance Lead translates emerging AI regulations, ethical principles, and risk requirements into practical, scalable guardrails that enable responsible innovation rather than create barriers to business value. title: Forensic Psychology Dissertation Chair/Committee Member Faculty
description:
Opportunity at a Glance
The Forensic Psychology PhD program. Adjunct faculty members' primary responsibility will be to chair and/or serve as second members on doctoral dissertation committees as methodologists and/or content experts. Infrequently, and based on student enrollment, Adjunct Faculty may be invited to instruct content courses or research methodology courses for which they are credentialed to teach. Participation in Mentor Training will be provided and required.
Adjunct faculty members serve in a part-time capacity to educate Walden University students by effectively and proficiently using online technology and resources so that knowledge, information, feedback, and critique are imparted to and shared with students in thoughtful, carefully formulated, well-written, and timely communications. This is accomplished in an environment that is respectful of the student, the Faculty Member, Walden University, and the discipline in which the Faculty Member is involved. Faculty Members are expected to adhere to all Walden University Faculty expectations, which are clearly set forth to the Faculty Member at the start of their employment with the University.
Responsibilities

•
Dissertation Committee Service (Primary Responsibility): Chair and/or serve as a second committee member on doctoral dissertations, providing methodological and/or content expertise to forensic psychology doctoral candidates.

•
Training: All new Faculty Members receive specific training from Walden University in teaching techniques, use of the electronic learning platform, policies and procedures of the School or College in which they will teach, socialization into Walden University culture, assessment of academic integrity of student work (including use of www.turnitin.com), and research supervision of theses and dissertations.

•
Course Teaching (Secondary Responsibility): When assigned a course, Faculty Members teach using the Canvas platform and are responsible for interacting with students within it. Discussion boards are open 24/7; postings may be made at any time but must be completed in a timely manner per the Faculty Handbook. Responses to student questions must be posted within 48 hours. Faculty Members are required to verify the accuracy of student postings and submissions and to provide feedback and grades through Canvas.

•
Availability: Faculty are expected to be reasonably accessible to students, including outside the course discussion board, and to provide substantive feedback on assignments and postings. Faculty publish their availability through course syllabi, instructor information in the classroom, and/or other appropriate documents. Regular and predictable availability, such as online office hours or chats, is suggested.

•
Residencies: Faculty Members may be required to attend residencies held domestically or internationally to teach intensives and colloquia and facilitate school- and university-wide discussions. (Part-time faculty may, but are not required to, attend.)

• Performs other duties as assigned

• Complies with all Walden University policies and standards

• Ph.D. in Forensic Psychology or a related field from an accredited institution required

• Forensic experience at the doctoral level preferred

• One year of experience serving on doctoral committees preferred (experience chairing a committee preferred)

• Evidence of continuing scholarly or creative work within the past 5 years; proficient in APA 7th edition

• Strong research methodology background in quantitative, qualitative, and/or mixed methods (preference given to quantitative)

• Excellent leadership, communication, teamwork, and human relations skills

• At least 1,000 hours of direct forensic psychology experience over five years, or completion of a 2,000-hour formal postdoctoral fellowship in forensic psychology

Technology Requirements

• Adjunct faculty provide their own laptops and are expected to use the Walden University Learning Management System

The role
Pacaso created the category of co-owned luxury second homes. Our owners come to us for more time in the places they love, with the people they love. The Brand and Marketing Creative Principal makes that feeling visible in everything we put into the world, from the brand and the words to the videos, the photography and every home we bring to market.

title: RevOps Manager
description:
About Improvado
Improvado is an AI-powered marketing data platform built for mid-market and enterprise teams. We help companies automate complex marketing data workflows, unify data at scale, and surface insights through BI and AI. Brands like Genentech, T-Mobile, Activision, and H&R Block rely on us to simplify analytics and improve marketing performance.
We’re a fast-growing Series A startup backed by $34M in funding and driven by a team that moves fast, stays curious, and cares about high-quality execution.
About the role
Improvado is a marketing data platform for enterprise brands and agencies. You will own how our revenue runs and how it is measured. That covers Salesforce and the GTM tools, the path from signed contract to paid invoice, the revenue data model, and the reports leadership decides from. You work closely with the analytics team: you don’t have to build the data models yourself, but you must read them, spot what is wrong and say what to change. You work through AI agents daily, doing the work of a bigger team.
What you will do
Salesforce and GTM stack

• Own Salesforce configuration, release process and user access, plus the integrations around it (Gong, Clay, Lemlist, enrichment, e-signature, lead routing).

• Keep CRM data clean with guardrails that block mistakes. Manage licences and vendor renewals.

• Maintain the Salesforce manual and RevOps SOPs, and train new hires.

Contract to cash

• Own ARR and bookings logic (new, upsell, downsell, churn, renewals) and keep agreement, opportunity, and invoice consistent.

• Run the closed-deals and billing check with Finance. Fix errors at the source and add a control so they don’t repeat.

• Audit invoices, track and chase unpaid ones, and prepare quarterly commission and quota reports.

Revenue analytics and data model

• Own the quarterly sales analytics pack, the CRO report, the forecast and pipeline coverage (including CS renewal inputs).

• Track funnel conversion, explain why deals move, stall or slip, and keep attribution correct with Marketing.

• Query ClickHouse daily, trace any number to its source, and write specs for model changes. Give each metric one documented definition and add data quality checks.

• Build leadership dashboards, retire unused ones, and end every analysis with a recommendation, a number and an owner.

AI and automation

• Use coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) for queries, scripts and Salesforce automation, and always verify their output.

• Automate manual work (invoice and payment checks, CRM hygiene, deal-risk alerts, call analysis) and measure hours saved and errors avoided.

Ownership

• Be the single RevOps contact for Sales, CS, Marketing, Finance and Product. Turn each request into a task with an owner, date and success metric.
Requirements

• 4-6+ years in RevOps, Sales Ops or GTM systems in B2B SaaS, with hands-on admin of a live Salesforce org.

• Strong SQL and comfort in a modeled warehouse (layers, lineage, one definition per metric). dbt is a plus.

• Deep knowledge of the B2B SaaS revenue cycle: funnel, pipeline, forecast, ARR, churn, renewals.

• Experience running the money side: contracts, invoicing, collections, kept in sync with the CRM.

• Proof you build with AI agents: something you shipped that others use.

• Fluent English and clear written updates without being asked.

Nice to have

• Salesforce Administrator or Advanced Administrator certification.

• ClickHouse or another columnar warehouse, and any BI tool.

• Salesforce development (Apex, triggers, API).

• Gong, Clay, Lemlist, or workflow automation tools.

• Billing, CPQ, or accounting systems.

• HubSpot to Salesforce migration.

• Attribution or CS health score data.

• Martech or analytics company background.

What We Offer

• Remote-first environment

• Strong product/market fit: marketing data product for US-based enterprises

• 20 working days of PTO per year

• US holidays and additional days off

• Professional development reimbursement

title: Product Engineer - Platform Experience
description:
Board Intelligence is a technology and advisory firm on a mission to make boards more effective, and through them, build better businesses and benefit society.

Over twenty years we have established ourselves as the market leader in governance and board effectiveness, trusted by more than 80,000 directors, executives, and governance professionals globally, including across the Fortune 500, FTSE 100, and OMX 30. That trust has been earned through depth of insight, rigorous advisory work, and a track record that newer entrants simply cannot replicate.

We have invested in applied AI since 2020, well ahead of the market, and that early conviction has paid off. Our AI-powered platform and smart board advisor give us a competitive advantage that is widening, not narrowing. In 2024, K1 Investment Management, the leading B2B Enterprise SaaS investor, backed us to accelerate that position further. We are now growing fast, with a proven commercial model spanning both mid-market and enterprise, and a product suite that has become a necessary addition in high-stakes board environments.

The people joining us now will shape how we scale. We are deliberate about how we do that. Our founders and leadership team are deeply invested in keeping the culture that got us here: thoughtful, high calibre, and genuinely human. Ambition and balance are not in competition at Board Intelligence .

If you want to work at the intersection of AI and governance, on problems that matter at the highest level, this is a strong place to be.

Our Mission
We unleash the potential of organisations through the science of board effectiveness, building better businesses and benefitting society.
The Role

Board Intelligence 's software is used by boards and leadership teams at some of the most heavily regulated organisations in the world, including major financial services firms. They trust us with their most sensitive information, and they expect our platform to meet the highest standards of security.

We are setting up a new Platform Experience team to build the web applications and APIs that power the whole platform, rather than features for individual products or clients. This is a product engineering role, not a platform or infrastructure role. Much of the work is in authentication and security, and many of the most interesting problems come from what large enterprise clients ask of us.

There is substantial work ready to start: a SCIM API so clients can automate user provisioning, and passkey (FIDO2) support. You will work alongside a highly experienced engineer who knows this area deeply. Our stack spans Ruby, TypeScript (React), Python and Java, and we are a Claude Code shop, with access from your first day.

Main Responsibilities

• Design, build and ship the web applications and APIs that underpin the Board Intelligence platform

• Lead work on platform features, such as authentication and identity, ensuring we have products that meet the expectations of our enterprise clients.

• Work directly with clients' IT and technology teams to understand their requirements, ask the right questions and push back where needed

• Build to the security and data protection standards that regulated financial services clients expect

• Work across our stack, including Ruby, TypeScript (React), Python and Java

• Share knowledge with colleagues and build depth in a critical part of the platform

• Use AI tools such as Claude Code to move faster, while keeping engineering standards high

Person Specification

Required Skills and Experience

• Upper mid-level to senior professional software engineering experience.

• Professional experience with Ruby, alongside at least one other language: we want an engineer who is comfortable across languages, but has significant Ruby experience

• Strong engineering foundations that carry across languages and frameworks, including system design, testing and code quality

• Experience building and maintaining web applications and APIs in pro

You will collaborate with recruiters, hiring managers, and interviewers to keep hiring processes organized, efficient, and on schedule.
In this role, you are expected to operate with reliability, urgency, and attention to detail. You will manage competing priorities, maintain accurate tracking documentation, and help reduce recruiting friction by ensuring scheduling, communication, and follow-through are handled consistently and professionally.
This is a blended role:

• ~50% sourcing support across global searches

• ~30-50% interview scheduling and recruiting coordination

The environment is high volume and deadline-driven. We need someone who thrives in pace, structure, and clear execution.
Key Responsibilities
Sourcing (Approx. 50%)

• Partner with Recruiters to understand role requirements and timelines

• Source candidates globally across technical and delivery roles

• Conduct proactive outreach and manage candidate pipelines

• Track sourcing metrics

Recruiting Coordination (Approx. 30-50%)

• Schedule interviews across multiple time zones

• Coordinate calendars with candidates and internal interviewers

• Send confirmations and ensure a smooth candidate experience

• Maintain interview tracking and documentation

• Support offer logistics and administrative follow-through

Qualifications

• 2+ years of sourcing, recruiting coordination, or talent operations experience

• Fluent English (written and spoken)

• Experience scheduling across global time zones

• Comfortable in high-volume environments

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

• Reliable internet connection and ability to work within global business hours as needed

What We’re Looking For

• Calm under pressure

• Strong sense of urgency

• Clear communicator

• Process-oriented and highly dependable

This is a 3-month contractor engagement with potential to extend or transition into a permanent role depending on business needs and performance.

We run recruiting operations that support real delivery teams, real clients, and real deadlines.

description:

Commitment: Approximately 50 hours per week
Industry: Healthcare technology experience is preferred but not mandatory
About the Company
Zenara Health is a technology-oriented mental healthcare organization building clinical software for behavioral-health clinics. We work with sensitive patient data, so security, access control, vendor risk, AI-tool risk, and evidence of how our controls operate are fundamental to earning customer trust.
We are a startup, not a department. We move quickly and need a security and compliance program that is rigorous enough for healthcare and practical enough to work in a small, fast-moving company.
About the Role
We are looking for a Senior Security & Compliance Lead to build and own Zenara’s security and compliance program.
You will set risk priorities, define security and HIPAA-related controls, verify that they work, and lead our responses to customer security reviews. You will work closely with the Head of Engineering and our Platform Engineer, who owns day-to-day platform operations and implements and operates many of the technical controls.
You own the program’s direction and outcomes. The Platform Engineer owns the day-to-day operation of the platform. You will work together to turn security requirements into working practices, not just documents.
Here is the test: can you inspect a real technical environment, identify the risks that matter most, explain the trade-offs, and work with engineers to implement and verify effective controls?
We are not looking for someone who only produces compliance paperwork. We need a leader with healthcare security judgment, technical depth, and the willingness to remain involved until a control actually works.
Our Security and Compliance Vision
Security and compliance should be part of how Zenara operates every day-not a last-minute exercise when a customer sends a questionnaire.
You will build a program with clear control owners, practical policies, current evidence, tracked remediation, and tested response procedures. It should give engineering a safe path to move quickly while helping us protect patient data and answer customer questions with confidence.
Your remit includes:

• HIPAA-related safeguards, policies, and evidence

• Security risk assessment and remediation priorities

• Technical control standards and verification

• Patient-data flows and access controls

• Vendor and AI-tool risk

• Customer security reviews and audit preparation

• Incident response and escalation procedures

• Security practices for AI-assisted engineering

The goal is not to create the largest possible program. It is to establish the right controls, make ownership clear, and ensure those controls keep working as Zenara grows.
What You’ll Do

• Own the security and compliance roadmap, including risk prioritization, remediation tracking, and follow-through.

• Establish and maintain HIPAA-related policies, procedures, control requirements, and supporting evidence.

• Review cloud infrastructure, access controls, secrets management, and other technical safeguards with the Platform Engineer.

• Review patient-data flows, vendors, AI tools, and LLM-related data risks.

• Set requirements for how AI agents and tools access data, systems, and production environments.

• Lead responses to customer security questionnaires and coordinate preparation for audits or other external reviews.

• Establish incident response and escalation procedures, and help coordinate the response to significant security events.

title: AI SecOps Manager
description:
CyberMSI is a U.S.-based managed XDR and compliance firm built to stop cyberattacks before business disruption happens.We've an "AI + analyst-on-the-loop" SOC model where AI moves at machine speed while analysts remain accountable for decisions that impact the business.

Powered by Microsoft Unified Security Operations using Microsoft Defender XDR and Microsoft Sentinel SIEM, we protect AI agents, identities, apps, data, endpoints, multi-cloud, and third-party access.

We use AI to accelerate correlation of attack signals, enable rapid threat containment, and execute response actions or approval workflows based on real business context, not generic playbooks.

Our difference is not AI-based automation alone; it is Accountable & Intelligent automation.
We’re growing fast and are seeking anAI SecOps Manager to lead our SOC, scale AI-assisted processes, and ensure high-quality customer work products. This role combines operational leadership with AI-driven SOC orchestration, enabling optimized detection, investigation, and response workflows while driving adoption of GenAI-assisted automation and analytics.
What you’ll do:

• Lead and manage day-to-day SOC operations across multiple environments, integrating AI-assisted workflows to ensure timely and accurate incident detection and response.

• Oversee AI-driven SecOps processes, implementing automation, GenAI orchestration, and operational guardrails to enhance efficiency and consistency.

• Mentor and develop SOC Leads, Analysts, and AI-assisted teams, fostering a culture of continuous improvement, AI adoption, and operational excellence.

• Collaborate with Threat Detection, Threat Validation, Automation, and QA teams to refine AI-assisted workflows, close gaps, and drive SOC operational maturity.

• Provide strategic reporting, recommendations, and stakeholder communications to executive leadership, ensuring SLA adherence, KPI achievement, and informed decision-making.
What you’ll bring:

• Minimum 7years of experience in SOC management, security operations, or incident response leadership.

• Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender XDR and Sentinel SIEM.

• Strong understanding of AI-assisted security operations, alerts, and investigation workflows.

• Proven leadership experience managing multiple teams in an MDR environment.

• Strong knowledge of cloud, endpoint, identity, and email security threat landscapes.

• Ability to translate complex operational challenges into clear, actionable strategies.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Experience implementing SOAR, automation, and GenAI-driven workflows in a SOC environment.

• Relevant certifications such as SC-200 is a plus.
What we’ll offer:

• Market competitive base pays and twice-yearly performance-based bonuses.

• Monthly allowances for health insurance, laptop, and internet.

• Paid time off for up to 20 days every year plusall government holidays.

• Opportunity to work internationally from CyberMSI’slocations in the USA, UAE, and other locationsthrough intra-company assignments.

• Ongoing training on latest cybersecurity and AI technologies.

• Reimbursements for relevant cybersecurity certifications.

title: Senior Manager, Billing & Payments
description:
About ECP

ECP is a market-leading SaaS solution that enables senior living communities to better care for their residents. ECP is used in over 8,000 communities. We're looking to further expand by increasing the number of customers that use our software and increasing the scope of how we serve our customers by developing and releasing new products.
Senior living is deeply under-penetrated with software, and ECP is one of the largest and fastest-growing software companies in the industry. We recently raised a growth round of equity to reinvest in our product, technology, and go-to-market. Our mission is to build world-class software that improves the quality of life for seniors and improves clinical, business, compliance, and operational performance for our customers.
The Role
Billing & Payments are among ECP 's newest products, and customer needs and workflows vary significantly from one implementation to the next. What one customer needs from us on reconciliation or journal entry configuration, another doesn't. You'll lead through that ambiguity, building the team, methodology, and standards that turn each implementation into something the next one can learn from.
You'll lead ECP 's Billing & Payments customer adoption, owning how new customers go live and adopt the products, and making sure what we learn feeds back into the roadmap. You'll manage the Billing Consultants who serve as subject matter experts supporting implementations. You'll also stay close to our most complex customers and continue to refine implementations to support a scalable, repeatable operating model.
You'll report to the VP of Billing, Payments & Data and work closely with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, Sales, and Leadership. This role will be key to Billing & Payments' success as products.
What You'll Own
Team leadership. Hire, onboard, coach, and develop a team of Billing Consultants, starting with one today, with room to grow. Set clear expectations, manage performance, and build a team culture grounded in financial rigor and customer partnership.
Implementation leadership. Partner with the wider Implementation team to support enterprise implementations from kickoff to go-live: methodology, staffing and capacity planning, quality standards, and outcomes across the full portfolio. Lead or support our most complex and strategic implementations, serving as a financial operations expert on journal entry configuration, reporting requirements, and reconciliation.
Payments. Own the operational strategy behind ECP 's payment processing product. Partner with our Product and Engineering teams and our payment processing partner to shape the payments roadmap.
Accounting integrations. Oversee end-to-end accounting integrations: data flows, configuration requirements, and downstream financial reporting impacts. Set standards the team follows and step in on the most complex integrations.
Customer adoption and partnership. Make sure customers understand not just how to use Billing & Payments, but how the products support their financial and operational goals. Act as a trusted advisor and escalation point for Finance, Accounting, and Operations leaders via Zoom, email, phone, and occasional on-site visits.
Risk and escalation management. Own escalations and incident resolution for billing issues that could affect revenue accuracy, financial reporting, or customer trust. Communicate clearly with customer and internal leadership, with context, financial impact, and a recommended path forward.
Metrics and reporting. Define and track the metrics that show how Billing & Payments are performing, such as time to go-live, implementation backlog, adoption, post-go-live ticket volume, escalations, and customer satisfaction. Report on them to leadership and use them to drive improvement.

title: Job Description: Senior Security Engineer - Fully Remote (Spain)
description:
If you love getting hands-on with web security, cloud infrastructure and the emerging risks of AI and LLM integrations, you’ll feel right at home with us. At Metricool you will be able to do so with real ownership over how security and compliance get built into the product, not just audited after the fact.
You will have the possibility to work 100% remotely, working in a high-growth international B2B SaaS, in which all members love to create, work in teams, analyze and help Community Managers make their work easier.
Your mission is to become the dedicated owner of application, cloud and AI security at Metricool, relieving our Senior Developers and Leads from manual security reviews and building specialized security management across our core monolith (JavaEE, Spring Security, Vue), AWS infrastructure, AI-powered features and internal compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2).
In this position, you will be able to make a wonderful contribution and impact in different areas:
As Senior Security Engineer,

• Application & Platform Security: Harden Spring Security, JavaEE filters, CORS, anti-CSRF protections, SameSite/HttpOnly cookie flags, and strict CSP headers.

• AI Security & Testing : Run threat modeling and vulnerability testing on our AI/LLM features, protecting against the OWASP Top 10 for LLMs: prompt injection, data poisoning, data leakage, insecure output handling, and API abuse.

• Compliance & Auditing (ISO 27001 / SOC 2): D efine, audit and collect technical evidence for compliance controls (access management, encryption at rest and in transit, incident logs), lead ISO 27001 and SOC 2 audits, and evaluate third-party vendor risk.

• Infrastructure & Cloud Security: Configure AWS load balancers, Nginx, Tomcat, container security (Docker), and HTTPS enforcement.

• Code Reviews & Audits: Run regular code reviews, secret-detection audits, and third-party dependency reviews (Maven, Node.js).

• Build automated security checks (SAST/DAST/ZAP) into our CI/CD pipelines.

As a Team Member:

• Cross-functional Alignment: Work closely with Senior Developers and Leads to bring security into the development process from the start, rather than bolting it on afterward.

• Continuous Improvement: Document controls, evidence and runbooks so compliance stays audit-ready year-round, not just ahead of a renewal.

• Culture of Excellence: Drive a security-first culture that embraces secure AI adoption without slowing down developer velocity.

Long story short: How will your first days in Metricool look like?

• First month: Gain full context of the monolith architecture, the AWS stack and our current compliance posture.

• First Quarter: Complete AI feature threat modeling, execute security header hardening, and set up the ISO 27001/SOC 2 evidence collection matrix.

• To the moon: Own platform security end to end, keep compliance continuous and seamless, and lead the secure adoption of new AI technologies.

Job requirements. You’ll be successful on your mission if you have:

• The candidate must be located in Spain.

• A senior profile, confident owning security end-to-end across application code, cloud infrastructure and compliance, not just reviewing it on paper.

• Languages: Professional fluency in Spanish (mandatory) and English. A language proficiency check is part of the hiring process.

Hard skills:

• JavaEE, Spring Security, Vue.js, Node.js, Docker, OWASP ZAP, AWS, Linux, MySQL, Maven, Git/Bitbucket.

• AI & Security: Understanding of the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, AI data privacy, and secure API/prompt engineering.

• Compliance Frameworks: Knowledge of ISO/IEC 27001 ISMS controls, SOC 2 Type II Trust Services Criteria (security, availability, confidentiality), and vendor risk assessments.

Soft skills:

• Hands-on mindset: comfortable writing and reviewing code, not a “paper compliance” auditor.

• Pragmatic approach to security: applies controls without imposing heavy bureaucratic overhead on development speed.

title: Product Manager
description: About Nous Nous is a household AI agent. It takes over the bills and admin people don't have time for and acts for them: switching energy, buying insurance, cancelling forgotten subscriptions, managing the family calendar. Nearly 250,000 UK households have signed up, and another joins every minute. We think the real value of AI isn't writing amazing cover letters, it's doing useful things in the real world for real people. That's the hard part, and a brilliant product is only half of it. An energy switch takes weeks, so our agents run on long-running workflows, not a single chat turn. Cancelling a subscription means a browser agent handling the code Apple sends to your phone. Buying insurance meant getting our regulatory principal comfortable with an agent doing it end to end (a UK first), which comes down to knowing exactly when the LLM should hand over to rules because a mistake would cost someone real money. We're about 30 people running one agent across energy, broadband, mobile, insurance, mortgages and subscriptions (with more being added), each with its own suppliers, rules and ways of going wrong. With far more problems than people, a person or small team owns each one end to end, from spotting it in the data or a customer conversation to shipping the fix. And because the agent acts, you find out quickly whether the fix worked. Everyone builds here: a product engineer launched our subscription cancellation product within a couple of months of joining, and a PM rebuilt our WhatsApp agent. And it's working. We're growing more than 20x year on year, with a market-leading NPS above +80, and we manage well over half a billion pounds of household spending. title: Vendor Onboarding & Risk Specialist
description:
Job Type:  Full-time | Location: Remote TX | Department:  Procurement | Reporting to: Procurement Manager| Work Location Type:  #remote

IREN is a leading AI Cloud Service Provider, delivering large-scale GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN ’s vertically integrated platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid-connected land and data centers in renewable-rich regions across the U.S. and Canada.
The Vendor Onboarding & Risk Specialist owns the end-to-end vendor onboarding process, ensuring that new and existing suppliers are qualified, documented, and approved in line with company policy before work is awarded or purchase orders are issued.
This role is responsible for coordinating vendor prequalification, non-disclosure agreements (NDAs), insurance and safety verification, financial and sanctions screening, and vendor master activation. The Specialist maintains the vendor risk register, monitors compliance status through the life of the supplier relationship, and ensures onboarding records are complete, current, and audit-ready.

With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever-evolving applications of high-performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way - responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in.

Responsibilities
Vendor Onboarding Coordination

• Own the intake, coordination, tracking, and closeout of new vendor and vendor change requests from initial request through approval and system activation.

• Determine the required level of due diligence based on spend, scope, site access, criticality, and commercial or safety risk, and confirm required reviewers and approvers.

• Issue and collect vendor onboarding packages, including registration forms, banking and tax details, insurance certificates, safety documentation, and compliance attestations.

• Follow up with vendors and internal stakeholders on outstanding items and escalate delayed or blocked onboardings to the Procurement Manager.

• Coordinate vendor master setup and changes with Finance and Procurement once all approvals and documentation are complete.

• NDAs & Onboarding Agreements

• Coordinate the issuance, tracking, negotiation support, and execution of NDAs and other onboarding agreements using approved templates and Legal guidance.

• Maintain the NDA register, including counterparties, effective and expiry dates, scope, and status, and ensure executed copies are filed and retrievable.

• Confirm that an executed NDA is in place before confidential information is shared with prospective or existing suppliers.

• Flag non-standard terms or vendor redlines to Legal and track resolution through signature.

• Prequalification, Insurance & Safety Compliance

• Administer the vendor prequalification process, including collection and review of safety programs, incident statistics, certifications, licences, and WorkSafeBC or equivalent clearance letters.

title: Active Directory / Identity Engineer (Senior)
description:
Computer World Services, Corp. (CWS) seeks a Senior Active Directory / Identity Engineer to own and sustain the Microsoft Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS) environment supporting the USMEPCOM ENLIST program. This senior engineering position manages AD objects, organizational units, Group Policy Objects (GPOs), trusts, replication, schema governance, delegated permissions, domain services, and recovery capabilities.

The engineer also evaluates and tests approved Identity, Credential, and Access Management (ICAM) capabilities, including potential Okta integrations. These modernization activities complement, not replace, the need for direct, hands-on AD DS engineering expertise. The engineer works closely with cybersecurity, Service Desk, systems, cloud, network, application, COOP, and Government identity stakeholders.

Key Tasks & Responsibilities

• Serve as senior technical owner for the USMEPCOM AD DS environment, maintaining the domain, OU, site, trust, and Group Policy plans and related architecture documentation.

• Install, configure, maintain, troubleshoot, and recover AD DS, and create, modify, disable, and delete authorized users, computers, groups, service accounts, and other directory objects.

• Design and maintain the OU structure, and manage OU permissions and delegated administration using least-privilege principles, correcting excessive or conflicting access.

• Develop, test, deploy, and troubleshoot GPOs, including links, inheritance, precedence, security filtering, WMI filters, backups, and recovery; assess changes for security and customer impact before production.

• Configure, validate, and troubleshoot domain and forest trusts, reviewing direction, transitivity, authentication scope, and name-suffix routing.

• Maintain AD sites, subnets, site links, and replication topology; troubleshoot replication failures, latency, and lingering objects; and maintain domain-controller health, SYSVOL, DFSR, time sync, AD-integrated DNS, and FSMO roles.

• Plan and execute domain-controller installation, upgrade, demotion, and retirement and transitions to supported AD versions; govern and coordinate controlled schema extensions.

• Process escalated account, group, and permission changes; troubleshoot authentication, authorization, policy, trust, and replication issues; and improve identity-related Service Desk routing and knowledge content.

• Provide advanced support during identity and authentication incidents, escalate widespread failures through incident-response procedures, and support root-cause analysis and corrective actions.

• Develop, maintain, and test AD backup, authoritative and non-authoritative restoration, deleted-object recovery, and forest-recovery procedures, and support COOP and disaster-recovery exercises.

• Support integration testing between AD and Okta or other approved identity platforms, validating synchronization, authentication flows, attribute and group mappings, provisioning, and SAML, OIDC, OAuth, SCIM, or LDAP protocols, and documenting test results.

• Automate approved directory administration, health validation, and reporting; review audit information; apply DISA STIGs and security baselines; and support RMF controls, POA&M activities, and remediation.

• Maintain SOPs, recovery plans, configuration baselines, and directory diagrams, and provide directory-service health, risk, and modernization information for program reporting.

Education & Experience

Required:

• Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience where permitted by the labor category.

• Minimum of eight (8) years of relevant experience in Active Directory engineering, identity engineering, Windows infrastructure, systems engineering, or a related discipline.

• Direct, hands-on experience engineering and administering Microsoft AD DS in an enterprise environment, including objects, OUs, GPOs, trusts, replication, schema, delegated

Your Impact at LILA

The PS AI team sits at the intersection of Physical Sciences R&D and AI/ML. Lila runs high-throughput experiments across electrochemistry, formulations, and advanced materials, generating rich datasets that demand more than black-box models.

As a Co-Op focused on AI-driven equation discovery, you will develop and benchmark methods that extract interpretable governing equations directly from that data. Discovered equations reveal the underlying physics, make predictions explainable, and serve as mechanistic building blocks for digital twins and closed-loop optimization.

You will work alongside PS AI researchers and physical scientists, helping shape how Lila turns experimental data into scientific understanding at scale.

What You'll Be Building

• Build end-to-end equation discovery pipelines from preprocessing through candidate generation and validation

• Benchmark symbolic regression methods (SINDy, PDE-FIND, PySR, LLM-guided search) on Lila campaign data

• Apply equation discovery to live electrochemistry, formulation, and materials datasets

• Translate open scientific questions into concrete problems with datasets, baselines, and success criteria

• Document and present findings across PS AI and domain science teams

• Pursuing a Master's or PhD in ML, CS, applied math, physics, materials science, or chemical engineering

• Strong Python skills with hands-on experience in PyTorch, JAX, or similar

• Experience applying machine learning to messy, real-world scientific or experimental data

• Solid grounding in linear algebra, calculus, and probability

• Comfort reading and implementing methods from ML research papers

• Ability to frame open-ended scientific questions as concrete ML tasks

• Clear communication across research, engineering, and physical science teams

• Background in physics-informed ML, uncertainty quantification, or operator learning (PINNs, neural ODEs, FNO, DeepONet)

• Exposure to digital twin or closed-loop workflows: model calibration, active learning, Bayesian optimization

• Domain knowledge in electrochemistry, formulations, superconductors, or materials science

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

title: Technical Woodworks and Metalworks Draftsman
description:
Technical Woodworks and Metalworks Draftsman
ABOUT THE ROLE
Our client is seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Technical Draftsman (Woodworks & Metalworks) to develop accurate technical drawings, 3D models, and production-ready documentation for custom wood and metal fabrication projects.
The role involves translating design concepts, sketches, and engineering specifications into detailed fabrication drawings for projects such as kitchens, closets, built-in cabinetry, custom furniture, pergolas, shading structures, roof frameworks, gates, doors, and other bespoke fabrication works.
The successful candidate will collaborate closely with designers, architects, engineers, project managers, and production teams to ensure all drawings meet project specifications, fabrication requirements, quality standards, and deadlines.
COMPANY OVERVIEW
Our client is a design studio specializing in technical design and production drawings for custom wood and metal fabrication.
Their work focuses on bridging the gap between concept and manufacturing by translating ideas, sketches, and specifications into accurate 3D models and clear technical documentation ready for real-world production.
They work closely with carpenters, metal workshops, architects, and designers to ensure every drawing is optimized for fabrication processes, materials, and assembly requirements.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Prepare detailed technical drawings, plans, schematics, and 3D models for custom wood and metal fabrication projects.

• Translate sketches, design concepts, engineering data, and project specifications into accurate and production-ready technical drawings.

• Develop shop drawings, cutting lists, joinery details, exploded views, and fabrication details for woodworking and cabinetry projects.

• Produce detailed fabrication drawings for metalwork projects, including pergolas, shading structures, roof frameworks, gates, doors, and steel structures.

• Incorporate technical details such as dimensions, materials, joints, screws, bolts, hinges, and assembly requirements.

• Apply CNC machining and modeling techniques where required for woodworking and production.

• Review, update, and revise drawings to reflect design changes, project developments, and actual site conditions.

• Coordinate with designers, architects, engineers, project managers, carpenters, and metal fabrication teams to ensure alignment with project requirements.

• Ensure all technical drawings are accurate, complete, and compliant with project specifications, fabrication standards, and quality requirements.

• Provide technical support and clarification to production teams throughout the fabrication and installation process.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Proven hands-on experience in technical drafting, woodworking, carpentry, cabinetry, or metal fabrication.

• Strong understanding of wood and metal materials, fabrication methods, and manufacturing processes.

• Ability to read, interpret, and execute technical drawings, sketches, and engineering specifications.

• Proficiency in relevant technical design and CAD software, such as:

• SolidWorks

• Inventor

• Cabinet Vision

• TopSolid

• Experience producing accurate, detailed, and production-ready 2D and 3D technical drawings.

• Hands-on experience with CNC machining and modeling, particularly for woodworking projects.

• Experience in kitchens, closets, built-ins, doors, custom furniture, steel structures, or other bespoke fabrication projects.

• Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and technical documentation.

• Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and meet project deadlines.

• Professionalism, accountability, and effective communication skills.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience with Rhino for 3D modeling and technical design.

• Experience with Grasshopper for design automation.

• Knowledge of both woodworking and metal fabrication processes.

• Experience in complex fabrication projects and on-site installation.

Position Overview
Globalli is seeking a Proposal & Bid Manager to lead the end-to-end proposal and bid lifecycle for enterprise, mid-market, government, and public-sector opportunities, as well as strategic client renewals and expansions.
This role will serve as the central owner and project manager for RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, tenders, procurement questionnaires, government solicitations, and other formal competitive processes. The Proposal & Bid Manager will partner closely with Sales, Solutions Consulting, Legal, Finance, Product, Technology, Information Security, Compliance, Implementation, Operations, and executive leadership to develop accurate, compelling, compliant, commercially competitive submissions.
The ideal candidate combines exceptional proposal management and writing skills with a strong commercial mindset. This person will understand how to translate Globalli 's global payroll, workforce technology, compliance, implementation, security, and commercial capabilities into persuasive, customer-specific responses designed to win business.
Key Responsibilities
Proposal & Bid Management

• Own the end-to-end management of RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, tenders, procurement questionnaires, and formal proposal processes.

• Analyze solicitation requirements, evaluation criteria, mandatory qualifications, contractual requirements, risks, deadlines, and submission requirements.

• Develop bid plans, response matrices, timelines, ownership assignments, review cycles, and submission schedules.

• Coordinate cross-functional contributors and ensure complete, accurate, consistent, and timely submissions.

• Manage multiple concurrent bids with competing priorities and immovable deadlines.

Government & Public-Sector Opportunities

• Manage government and public-sector bids from solicitation through submission, clarification, negotiation, and award.

• Identify procurement, contractual, compliance, security, insurance, financial, technical, and documentation requirements requiring internal review or escalation.

• Maintain organized records of solicitations, amendments, clarification questions, submissions, procurement communications, evaluations, and awards.

Sales Enablement & Deal Strategy

• Partner with Sales leadership and Account Executives on strategic enterprise and government opportunities.

• Develop customer-specific messaging, executive summaries, value propositions, competitive differentiators, and win themes.

• Support clarification rounds, bidder conferences, presentations, demonstrations, Best and Final Offers, commercial negotiations, and award processes.

• Support structured bid/no-bid decisions based on strategic fit, revenue potential, customer requirements, competitive position, probability of award, delivery feasibility, resources, and risk.

Existing Client Expansion & Renewals

• Manage formal procurement processes associated with renewals, competitive rebids, geographic expansion, and expanded scopes of service.

• Partner with Account Management and Commercial leadership to support retention and expansion opportunities.

• Coordinate responses involving Globalli 's Global Payroll, Employer of Record, Contractor Management, Entity Management, workforce technology, payments, and related services.

Proposal Content & Knowledge Management

• Develop persuasive, customer-specific proposal content that clearly differentiates Globalli .

• Build and maintain a centralized proposal content library covering products, global coverage, implementation, security, privacy, compliance, integrations, service levels, commercial models, references, and standard responses.

• Establish standardized templates, response frameworks, and quality standards.

• Continuously improve content based on product changes, regulatory developments, market positioning, customer feedback, and bid outcomes.

About us

Ocado Group is a UK-based company that is one of the world's largest dedicated online grocery retailers, we also operate our own grocery and general merchandise retail businesses under Ocado.com. We provide services to partner clients globally via our innovative advanced robotics technology, known as the Ocado Smart Platform ("OSP"), this drives our highly automated, multi-million dollar Customer Fulfillment Centers (CFCs). What You Will Do

The Senior Maintenance Engineer will report directly to the respective shift assigned Engineering Team Manager.  This position will undertake reactive and planned engineering maintenance activities and improvement works at the Customer Fulfillment Center (CFC) on mechanical handling equipment (MHE) such as conveyor networks, lifts, cranes, belts, etc.

The Senior Maintenance Engineer’s day-to-day responsibilities include:

• Reacting to MHE breakdowns (both mechanical and electrical), locating the fault, analyzing the issue and completing the fix in a timely manner to keep operation downtime to a minimum.

• Keeping accurate records such as work activities, tasks carried out, parts used through stores, etc.

• In addition, the position will be involved in projects within the business to develop an effective engineering installation and commissioning.

title: Head of Retention
description:
Is this you?

• You've owned retention at a subscription business where most revenue came from renewals.

• You want to own a number outright, not support the person who owns it.

• You'd rather be handed something broken and left alone than handed a plan and asked to run it.

• You think in weeks - though some results take two to three months to read. Waiting three meetings for a decision makes you itch.

• If you need everyone to agree before you move, this will frustrate you.

The problem
We're good at getting people to buy. Someone watches a long video sales letter, buys a multi-bottle offer, and their first renewal comes a few weeks later. We are not good enough at what happens next - too many never take a third shipment.
Closing that gap is worth more than anything else on the marketing roadmap, and right now it belongs to nobody. It would belong to you.
What you'd own
Six measures, tracked weekly: third shipment taken, churn, take rate, failed renewals recovered, self-serve retention, and net revenue per new subscriber in the first 90 days. Five outright, one you influence.
Underneath them: every message a subscriber gets in their first 90 days, the cancel flow and the offers in it, the subscriber portal, the save rules the phone team follows, and the test roadmap. A two-person team builds what you decide to build.
Most of it you decide and tell the CMO afterward. You don't ask first. A few, like the subscription offer at checkout, you shape with the teams that run them.
What you'd be good at

• Reporting a number you own in a bad week, without softening it

• Finding the cause that's true rather than the one that's comfortable

• Killing a test you designed, on the date you set before launch

• Checking a figure against a second source before you say it

• Pulling and checking your own numbers rather than waiting on an analyst

We're data-heavy and use AI tools daily, Claude especially. You won't build or send campaigns. Your team does.
One thing we won't ask you to do: trap people. We don't keep subscribers by making cancellation hard.
You're probably our person if
You've owned first- or second-renewal retention at a subscription business doing $50M+ or carrying 20,000+ subscribers, where most revenue came from renewals rather than new orders. You've run a cancel-and-save program end to end, managed people for three years or more, and would rather have real authority over one number than an opinion on five. Eight-plus years in retention, lifecycle or subscription roles. Supporting the owner doesn't count.
Pay and terms
$175,000 to $210,000 base depending on experience. 15% target bonus on company EBITDA. Full-time W-2, fully remote, unlimited PTO after 90 days, health and 401(k), six-month probationary period.
How this goes
A written answer, a short call, an interview on your career job by job, a 30-minute live read of a data table with no prep, a final with leadership, and reference calls. Six steps, none wasted.
If that's the job you've been waiting for someone to hand you, apply.
Company Values
We are Obsessed With What People Respond To. We are Scrappy. We are Kaizen. We Follow Through. We Give a Damn. We Win and Help Win.
